<!-- One place per pull request. The rules are in CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

Which place, and what changed:

- [ ] One place, one file: `overrides/<id>.json` or `additions/x-<slug>.json`, and the `id` inside is the file name
- [ ] `source` is the shop's own page (its website, its own ordering page, its official Instagram or Facebook) or the chain's own store locator. Not Google Maps, Yelp or any other listing site, and not a guess
- [ ] `checked` is the day I read it
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` passes

Changing code and not data? Delete the list and say what the change does.
